items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: that's when I met Matthew Gee and we used to practice.

ctx.x: Yeah. I had a room right

across the street. And...I think it was the Carlton Hotel and there was plenty of places to eat right in there and the musicians were there all the time and the different bands were comin' in. I think the Alabama State Collegians with the Trenier twins were workin' up the street and that's when I met Matthew Gee and we used to practice. And I met...let's see who else did I meet? ...who else was in that band? Oh...we used to call him "The Saint", Austin, Johnny Austin. He played tenor, from Houston, Texas. We…
